desc:
7 oz. Box of Annie's Bunny Grahams Friends Whole Grain Graham Snacks

Made with Organic Wheat

No Artificial Flavors, Synthetic Colors, or Preservatives

8g of Whole Grain

Honey, Chocolate, and Chocolate Chip Bunny Grahams
features:
Features:

Organic & Non-GMO

Made with USDA certified organic ingredients and free from genetically modified organisms.

Three Flavors in One

A fun mix of chocolate, chocolate chip, and honey flavors for variety in every handful.

Bunny-Shaped Fun

Cute, playful bunny shapes make them appealing to kids and nostalgic for adults.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors

Crafted with real ingredients—no high-fructose corn syrup, synthetic dyes, or preservatives.

Wholesome Snacking Option

Made with whole wheat flour and sweetened with cane sugar.

Lunchbox & On-the-Go Friendly

Convenient for packed lunches, road trips, or after-school snacks.

Benefits:

Kid-Approved, Parent-Trusted

Tasty enough for children, made responsibly enough for parents to feel confident.

Balanced Sweetness

Offers just the right touch of sweetness without overloading on sugar.

Great for Sharing

Ideal for parties, lunch snacks, or mixed into DIY trail mix.

Supports Smarter Snacking

Portion-controlled shapes help avoid overeating, while still satisfying cravings.

Naturally Delicious

Real cocoa, honey, and chocolate chips deliver authentic flavor in every bite.
ingredients: Organic Wheat Flour, Organic Cane Sugar, Organic Expeller-Pressed Sunflower Oil, Organic Whole Wheat Flour (graham flour), Organic Corn Flour, Organic Invert Cane Syrup, Organic Chocolate Cookie Bits (organic wheat flour, organic sugar, organic expeller-pressed sunflower oil, organic malted black barley flour, organic cocoa, baking soda), Organic Honey, Calcium Carbonate, Organic Cocoa Powder, Organic Natural Flavor, Baking Soda, Organic Semi-sweet Chocolate Chips (organic cane sugar, organic unsweetened chocolate, organic cocoa butter, organic vanilla extract), Sea Salt, Organic Rosemary Extract (to protect flavor).
